key.name: toggle-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to open/close the clipboard history popup.

key.name: max-history-size
key.description: The maximum number of clipboard entries to keep in history. Range: 5-200.

key.name: max-preview-length
key.description: Maximum number of characters to show in text preview. Range: 20-500.

key.name: clear-on-boot
key.description: Clear non-pinned clipboard history when GNOME Shell starts.

key.name: enable-images
key.description: Track image clipboard entries such as screenshots.

key.name: show-timestamps
key.description: Show relative timestamps on clipboard entries (e.g. "2 min ago").

key.name: paste-on-select
key.description: Automatically simulate Ctrl+V after selecting a clipboard entry.

key.name: private-mode
key.description: When enabled, clipboard changes are not recorded to history.

key.name: show-notifications
key.description: Show a brief notification when a new item is copied to the clipboard.

key.name: window-width
key.description: Width of the Recall popup window in pixels.

key.name: window-height
key.description: Height of the Recall popup window in pixels.

key.name: confirm-clear
key.description: Show a confirmation dialog before clearing the entire clipboard history.

key.name: pinned-on-top
key.description: Show pinned items at the top of the list, above regular history.
